questions.prompt: An aircraft flies at 450 mph for 2.5 hours. How far does it travel?
A jacket costs $80. It is discounted 25%, and then 5% sales tax is added to the sale price. What is the final cost?
Crew A can complete an inspection in 6 hours. Crew B can complete it in 3 hours. Working together, how long will it take?
questions.explanation: Rates add: 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/6 + 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2 job per hour, so 2 hours.

questions.prompt: An airplane burns 12 gallons of fuel per hour and carries 90 gallons. The pilot must land with a 30-minute fuel reserve. How many hours can the plane fly before reaching the reserve?
questions.explanation: Reserve = 0.5 × 12 = 6 gallons. Usable fuel = 84 gallons. 84 ÷ 12 = 7 hours.

questions.prompt: A student's average on 4 tests is 85. What score is needed on the 5th test to raise the average to 87?
A squadron of 40 people has officers and enlisted members in a 3:5 ratio. How many are officers?
$2,000 is invested at 4% simple annual interest. How much interest is earned in 3 years?
questions.explanation: I = Prt = 2,000 × 0.04 × 3 = $240. $2,240 is the total balance, not the interest.

questions.prompt: Two jets leave the same base at the same time, flying in opposite directions at 400 mph and 500 mph. After how many hours will they be 2,700 miles apart?
questions.explanation: Moving apart, their speeds add: 900 mph. 2,700 ÷ 900 = 3 hours.

questions.prompt: A car travels 240 miles on 8 gallons of gas. How many miles per gallon does it get?
A pilot flies 600 miles in 1.5 hours. What is the average speed?
A store buys an item for $45 and marks it up 20%. What is the selling price?
12 is 15% of what number?
A recipe uses 3 cups of flour for 24 cookies. How many cups are needed for 60 cookies?
A worker earns $18 per hour, with time-and-a-half for hours over 40. How much does she earn for 46 hours?
A flight departs at 9:45 a.m. and lasts 2 hours 50 minutes. When does it arrive?
On a map, 1 inch represents 25 miles. How many miles do 3.4 inches represent?
A plane flies 60 miles at 30 mph, then another 60 miles at 60 mph. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
questions.explanation: Total time = 2 h + 1 h = 3 h. 120 miles ÷ 3 h = 40 mph. 45 (averaging the speeds) is the trap.

questions.prompt: A town of 2,000 people grows 10% per year. What is its population after 2 years?
Five consecutive integers add up to 115. What is the largest?
questions.explanation: The middle number is 115 ÷ 5 = 23, so the integers are 21 to 25.

questions.prompt: A 400-gallon tank is 20% full. It fills at 8 gallons per minute. How long until it is full?
Ann is 3 times as old as Ben. In 10 years, Ann will be twice as old as Ben. How old is Ben now?
A jar holds 25 coins, all dimes and quarters, worth $4.00 in total. How many quarters are there?
questions.explanation: If q = quarters: 25q + 10(25 − q) = 400, so 15q = 150 and q = 10.

questions.prompt: A shirt costs $36 after a 25% discount. What was the original price?
How many minutes are in 3.5 hours?
An aircraft has 2,400 pounds of fuel and burns 600 pounds per hour. How much fuel remains after 3 hours 15 minutes?
20 liters of a 30% solution are mixed with 30 liters of a 10% solution. What is the concentration of the mixture?
Four roommates split $2,100 rent equally. A fifth roommate joins. How much less does each person pay now?
$1,000 is invested at 5% interest, compounded yearly. What is the balance after 2 years?
A school needs 3 instructors for every 18 students. How many instructors are needed for 120 students?
A 6-foot person casts a 4-foot shadow. At the same time, a tree casts a 30-foot shadow. How tall is the tree?
questions.explanation: Height is 1.5 times the shadow (6 ÷ 4). 30 × 1.5 = 45 feet.

questions.prompt: A crew paints 3 hangars in 12 days. At the same rate, how many days will 5 hangars take?
A $200 item is discounted 20%, then the sale price is discounted another 10%. What is the final price?
The average of 6 numbers is 20. When one number is removed, the average of the rest is 18. What number was removed?
An aircraft climbs at 1,500 feet per minute from 2,000 feet to 11,000 feet. How long does the climb take?
One pipe fills a pool in 4 hours and another in 12 hours. How long do they take together?
A price drops from $80 to $68. What is the percent decrease?
questions.explanation: Change = $12. 12 ÷ 80 = 0.15 = 15%. (17.6% divides by the new price by mistake.)

questions.prompt: Sam earns $2,400 a month and saves 15% of it. How much does he save in a year?
Jet A leaves at 300 mph. One hour later, Jet B follows the same route at 400 mph. How many hours after Jet B departs does it catch up?
questions.explanation: Jet A has a 300-mile head start. B gains 100 mph, so 300 ÷ 100 = 3 hours.
